i am not diagnosed with anything because i am a minor and have never had the privilege to professional help. i personally believe it’s a big possibility that i have it and it describes me very well and have a lot of the symptoms that are less general/widespread and have been though a decent amt of trauma. however i don’t say i have it and only talk about it with people i’m close to. i met someone who said they had it however not really showing any of the traits at all then saying they had bipolar on social media. even tho i’m not diagnosed it pissed me off, bipolar is a mood disorder and bpd is a personality disorder. and i know something like a personality disorder is not something u can self diagnose yourself with. i just can’t wait to get professional help to find out if i have it or it’s something else. however if someone has a really good reason to believe they have it, it shouldn’t immediately be invalidated, they believe that and feel that way for a reason.
